claims.text: The PMO's Tongan-language release dated 'Aho 28 'o Tisema 2021 states that King Tupou VI appointed Hon. Siaosi 'Ofakivahafolau Sovaleni (Hu'akavameiliku) as Palēmia (Prime Minister) of Tonga, as recommended by the Fale Alea, under clause (kupu) 50A of the Constitution. It states that the premiership is reckoned from the day of appointment, which it gives as 27 Tisema 2021.
claims.locator: Release image, date line under 'ONGOONGO TUKUATU' and first and second body paragraphs
claims.uncertainty: The English rendering is this packet's reading, not an official translation. Hu'akavameiliku is printed in parentheses as a name form; no chiefly-title grant, date or rank is inferred. Read with the English release's 'with effect from', 27 Tisema is the effective date; neither release records the warrant's signature or presentation as a separate event.

scope_note: Tongan-language counterpart of the English release, published on its own PMO page as one JPEG image (newprimeminister2.jpg). Its third paragraph expects the Cabinet announcement 'apongipongi (tomorrow), Pulelulu 29 Tisema 2021, consistent with issue on 28 December; that forecast is not imported. A direct non-browser request for the page returned HTTP 403; the page HTML hash is not asserted.

visual_review.method: The 1275x1650 release image was viewed at full size: the 'Aho 28 'o Tisema 2021 date line, the kupu 50A appointment on the Fale Alea's recommendation, the name form Hu'akavameiliku, the 27 Tisema starting day and the 29 Tisema Cabinet forecast. The coat of arms was not used.
